name: Astronaut helmet

parts.name: body
parts.massBasis: Hollow composite shell (~4 mm fiberglass/epoxy layup) over ~1.3 m ellipsoidal envelope; 6 shell material refs indicate multi-panel construction with internal ribbing. Mass from surface-area × thickness × 1550 kg/m³ composite density plus ~25 % for neck ring, padding, and comm hardware. COM slightly below geometric centre due to heavier neck-ring hardware. Variance near thin-shell sphere value (≈1/6) adjusted for oblate shape and concentrated ring at base.

parts.name: visor pivot
parts.massBasis: Polycarbonate visor pane (3 material layers suggest inner/outer/anti-fog sheets ≈ 3 mm total) plus small metal pivot brackets at lateral edges. Mass dominated by curved transparent sheet; COM shifted forward (cz 0.38) because glass area concentrates toward front. Variance lower in z because the curved plate is thin in the depth direction; x/y values reflect a wide, moderately tall curved shell.
